paragraphs: Valarian Technologies is a dual-use technology company building critical tools to safeguard the future in an era of evolving global security challenges. You are looking for an experienced Senior MLOps / LLMOps Engineer to lead the deployment, monitoring, orchestration, and operational reliability of your production LLM applications and agentic AI platform. In this role you will bridge the gap between AI development and production infrastructure, ensuring multi‑step agentic workflows, data pipelines and retrieval‑augmented systems run reliably, securely and at scale within a large‑scale Kubernetes environment. This combination of mission focus and technical scope aligns directly with my background in building secure, high‑throughput AI services.

I have worked on LLM projects that required agentic design and I used Python to implement the core logic. My CI pipelines, built with GitHub Actions, orchestrated container builds and automated tests, while PostgreSQL stored intermediate state for multi‑step tool execution. I regularly consulted stakeholders to refine prompt chaining and function calling, ensuring that each agentic step behaved deterministically. This experience satisfies the requirement for llm expertise, agentic workflow knowledge and GitHub Actions proficiency, demonstrating that I can deliver reliable, scalable LLM services in a Kubernetes‑driven environment.

I have applied machine‑learning evaluation techniques using R and XGBoost to model churn propensity. By performing hyperparameter tuning I improved prediction accuracy and generated robust evaluation metrics that tracked model drift and performance over time. These activities directly address the evaluation requirement and showcase my ability to apply rigorous machine learning methods to assess and optimise model outputs. The focus on churn and propensity modelling illustrates my capacity to translate quantitative insights into actionable improvements for AI systems.
